fields.statement: QA at 48d2315c with a scratchpad build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a fresh git init + rhiza init + render repo: rhiza docs wrote docs/reference/cli.md (2667 lines, plus config.md and workflow-file.md), exit 0. QA at 48d2315c with a scratchpad build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a fresh git init + rhiza init + render repo: after rhiza docs, rhiza check passes. I appended a line to config.md, deleted workflow-file.md and added my own notes.md: rhiza check exits 1 with 'fail render docs/reference/config.md: differs from what rhiza docs writes' and 'fail render docs/reference/workflow-file.md: missing', both with next: rhiza docs, and notes.md is ignored. After rhiza docs it rewrote the two files and check exits 0 again. TestScripts/docs-reference-stale passes.

Real commands (`rhiza change new "x" --json`, version, tui app overview, api call check, describe run.findings, render), paths (.rhiza/log, rhiza.toml, github.com/x/rhiza) and unquoted prose are accepted.
